bookmarks.title: Ryven Second Brain Post
bookmarks.author: imryven
bookmarks.text: I still don’t understand why people keep building a Claude second brain from scratch when these 10 repos already built the whole system. They take in your sources, link them into a wiki, check every claim, and one of them runs fully on your own machine. 10 LLM_Wiki_SecondBrain runs the whole pipeline on a local model, with no cloud API.

bookmarks.title: Local Vault Note
bookmarks.author: samplekeeper
bookmarks.text: A local vault stores sources as Markdown you own, and wikilinks resolve to notes on disk without an API key.

bookmarks.title: Claim Check Note
bookmarks.author: samplekeeper
bookmarks.text: A claim check marks a sentence sourced only when it points at a note or a URL that contains the claim.
